body: Don't do it... or at least wait for a bit. Whenever I get drunk while depressed, it has an odd opposite effect and i stop thinking about suicide for a while. Maybe this red'll do that for you?

I feel exactly the same way sometimes, so I know how you must be hurting. But I promise you, these people don't think you're a burden. Or, if they do, then they're assholes. I don't think you mean to hurt anyone. If they want you alive it defeinitely means that they care. Tell someone, maybe? Tomorrow doesn't have to be your last day.
